ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_basics_title: So you are a vampire. Keep it quiet.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_basics_body:
Vampires survive because mortals think they are myths. The Masquerade keeps it that way. You must stay hidden.

You are dead: no breath, no heartbeat, no need for food. Avoid doctors, health scans, and people who know what to look for, especially the Curator.

Use your powers carefully. They are strong, but they draw attention. Blend in, act mortal, use ordinary tools when possible, and save supernatural tricks for real emergencies.

Learn your HUD, find other kindred if you can, and keep vitae above 300. A starving vampire is a dead vampire.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_masquerade_s: How to keep everyone from getting killed.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_masquerade_b:
The Masquerade is the shared lie that vampires do not exist. Kindred society enforces it because discovery threatens every vampire.

If mortals witness suspicious supernatural behavior, you may receive a Masquerade infraction. After three infractions, you are exiled and every vampire may turn against you.

The Curator can expose vampires with the Archive of the Kindred. High humanity grants a Masquerade ability that fools health analyzers and the Curator, but you will not heal normally while it is active.

If you break the Masquerade, expect hunters, hostile kindred, vulnerable vassals, and no mercy.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_humanity_bod:
Most kindred were human before the Embrace. Humanity is what lets them resist the Beast and keep enough restraint to pass among mortals.

Lower humanity makes it harder to interact with mortals, harder to stay active during daylight, and slower to recover from torpor.

Click the humanity counter on your HUD for detailed information. It is called Humanity because of tradition, even when not every kindred was human.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_society_subt: The Camarilla keeps order from the shadows.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_society_body:
A Prince is an elder vampire entrusted by the Camarilla to rule a territory. Princes track local kindred and enforce the Masquerade with an iron fist.

Many Princes employ a Scourge: a personal enforcer loyal only to them. Princes are expected to protect the Masquerade at all costs and deliver final death to dangerous or disobedient kindred.

The Camarilla is the most organized vampiric sect. It favors tradition, secrecy, and control of mortal society from behind the scenes.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_leveling_bod:
You grow stronger by meeting feeding requirements. Click your blood meter on the HUD to see progress toward the next rank.

If you have consumed enough vitae, sleeping in a coffin grants a rank. Ranks increase physical strength, health, feeding speed, blood capacity, and discipline points for new powers.

You also gain ranks slowly over time and when you vassalize a mortal servant.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_vitae_subtit: The blood that sustains the dead.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_vitae_body:
Vitae is the lifeblood that sustains every vampire. Your rank determines how much you can store and use.

Sources of vitae include crewmembers, monkeys, mice, and blood bags. Feed from crew regularly; animals will not sustain you forever.

When vitae is depleted, you may frenzy. In frenzy, the Beast takes over and drives you to attack nearby mortals. Feeding is the only way back to control.

All vampiric powers require vitae. Some spend it immediately, while others drain it continuously while active.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_combat_body:
Vampires have enhanced senses, undead physiology, resilience, and supernatural strength. You do not breathe, sleep, or eat, and fatal wounds can place you in torpor instead of killing you outright.

Your weaknesses are serious. Stakes paralyze you, disable powers, halt healing, and can prevent revival from torpor. Fire and lasers are extremely dangerous.

Breaking the Masquerade is also a combat weakness: it turns kindred and mortals against you.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_lair_body:
A lair is a claimed location where you can rest in a coffin and perform certain vampiric rituals. Some vampires need one; many are caught because of one.

You only truly need a lair if you plan to create vassals or use certain structures. To claim one, place a coffin somewhere hidden and rest inside it.

Once claimed, the area can anchor structures such as the Vassalization Rack or Blood Throne. Maintenance is obvious hiding ground: if someone finds your lair, they find your coffin, structures, vassals, and you.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_structures_s: Tools built from the Vampire crafting tab.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_structures_b:
The Vassalization Rack converts captured crewmembers into loyal vassals. Secure it in your lair, restrain the target, drag them onto the rack, and begin the process. Sharp tools can speed conversion.

Mindshields and strong loyalties must be weakened before conversion. Eldritch servants cannot be converted.

The Candelabrum radiates an unsettling aura that damages sanity. The Blood Throne broadcasts your words telepathically to all kindred on the station.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_vassals_subt: Broken mortals bound to your will.
ui.antag_info_vampire.guide_vassals_body:
Vassals are mortals who serve as your eyes, ears, and hands among the living. They can act while you remain hidden.

To create one, secure a Vassalization Rack in your lair, capture and restrain a target, then drag them onto the rack. The process breaks their will and binds them to you.

Sharp implements speed the process. Mindshields and strong loyalties must be weakened first, and eldritch servants are immune. A mindshield implant can free a vassal.

ui.antaginfobloodworm.alien_mind_desc: Your mind is not human. You do not feel ordinary cravings, fear, sadness, or joy, even while in a host.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.bleeding_desc: In a host, you are effectively blood and highly vulnerable to bleeding. Host bleeding damages you directly, including when the host is dead. Hosts bleed faster than normal.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.blood_consumption_: You grow by using Leech Blood or Invade Corpse to consume blood. Synthetic blood has limits. Your HUD shows blood levels, and examining targets gives advanced blood info.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.door_stalking_desc: As hatchling or juvenile, slide under doors to stalk victims. Be careful of people opening the door.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.doorcrawling_desc: Hatchlings and juveniles can slide under doors; adults cannot. Adults rely on breaking doors and ID access. Secure a strong location or host before adulthood.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.fast_food_desc: Entering corpses consumes blood very quickly. Blood gained while already in a host does not affect growth; duplicated synthetic blood is less effective.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.growth_stages_desc: Track growth in the status tab. At full growth you can incubate in a cocoon to reach the next stage. Juveniles gain blood spit, adults become extremely strong.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.high_heat_desc: Your species is vulnerable to heat and burns rapidly in hot environments. Your body is flammable. This still applies in hosts, though gear can mitigate it.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.inferior_biology_d: Hosts lack your advanced senses and are vulnerable to darkness and flashes. Use human tools like NVGs and protection gear to compensate.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.jail_time_desc: You can break restraints, lockers, and similar obstacles using Spit Blood interactions, or leave host and escape through vents/doors.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.jumpstart_desc: Adults can gather corpses as future hosts. Extra blood can rapidly push hatchlings into juvenile or adult stages.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.life_insurance_des: With very low blood volume you are ejected from host control. Use this as a last-chance escape mechanic.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.life_support_desc: Inside a host, most vital organs are not required except the brain. Lungs allow speech and liver allows chem processing. You can insert organs and cybernetics into hosts.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.meatshields_desc: Hosts are shields. Watch for fire, bleeding, cremators and gibbers. Heal hosts periodically with Inject Blood.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.medbay_buffet_desc: Medbay blood freezers are rich food sources. They are partly synthetic but high volume helps growth. Freezer noise can attract crew.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.nomadic_desc: With night vision and no territory constraints, you can thrive anywhere. Hatchlings ventcrawl; older forms break doors and obstacles.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.parasitism_desc: You can turn into blood and enter a corpse, using it as a host.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.regeneration_desc: You slowly heal over time. In a host this restores blood volume. You can inject blood into host tissues to rapidly heal them at the cost of your own health.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.reproduction_desc: At the final adult stage, you can reproduce to create three hatchlings, while reverting yourself to one hatchling.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.space_immunity_des: You are immune to low temperature and pressure and do not need to breathe. Your hosts also do not need to breathe, but their bodies are still vulnerable to space.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.stealthy_healing_d: Healing hosts in medbay instead of spending blood avoids pale skin and preserves blood for later abilities.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.surprise_worms_des: Leave your host for ambushes, especially as an adult. Block escape routes first: host exit takes three seconds.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.team_up_desc: Your kin often share goals. Wormspeak is understood only by kin. HUD markers help identify blood worm hosts.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.testing_desc: DeForest made single-use blood worm detectors. Security can order them. They are quick to use, painful for targets, and expensive.
ui.antaginfobloodworm.ventcrawling_desc: Hatchlings can ventcrawl. After maturing, you lose it and rely on doorcrawling, breaking doors and ID access. Secure a good spot or host before becoming juvenile.
ui.antaginfodemon.blood_jaunt_descriptio: You can dive in and out of blood to travel anywhere you need to be. You gain a speed boost after leaving a jaunt for surprise attacks. You can drag disabled victims through blood, consuming them and restoring health.
ui.antaginfodemon.monstrous_strike_descr: You can launch a devastating slam by right-clicking, capable of shattering bones in one strike. It helps prevent escapes by slowing wounded victims.
